lifecycle.initial_state: discovery-locked until a complete structured acceptance contract
lifecycle.user_turn: new turns revoke leases; explicit continuation advances the Task revision
lifecycle.approval: exact UserPrompt approval provenance or out-of-band user broker action
lifecycle.verification: successful isolated snapshot receipts must match unchanged live output
lifecycle.completion: all current receipts required before complete revokes the lease

write_lease_contract.acceptanceHash: bound to structured outcome, criteria, exclusions, assumptions, Task revision, and user provenance
write_lease_contract.baseTreeHash: Git HEAD plus outside-scope filesystem observation
write_lease_contract.evidence: regular project files re-attested on protected actions
